description: This file defines the VertexAIBatchTransformation class, which provides methods to convert between OpenAI batch request/response formats and Vertex AI batch request/response formats, including handling batch job status, extracting file IDs, and constructing requests for Google Cloud Vertex AI.

classes.name: VertexAIBatchTransformation
classes.description: Provides static and class methods to transform batch request and response data between OpenAI and Vertex AI formats, including extracting IDs, status, and file URIs.

methods.name: transform_openai_batch_request_to_vertex_ai_batch_request
methods.description: Converts an OpenAI batch request into a Vertex AI batch prediction job request.

methods.name: transform_vertex_ai_batch_response_to_openai_batch_response
methods.description: Transforms a Vertex AI batch prediction response into an OpenAI-compatible batch format.

methods.name: transform_vertex_ai_batch_list_response_to_openai_list_response
methods.description: Converts a list response from Vertex AI into an OpenAI-compatible list response.

methods.name: _get_batch_id_from_vertex_ai_batch_response
methods.description: Extracts the batch ID from a Vertex AI batch response.

methods.name: _get_input_file_id_from_vertex_ai_batch_response
methods.description: Retrieves the input file ID from a Vertex AI batch response.

methods.name: _get_output_file_id_from_vertex_ai_batch_response
methods.description: Retrieves the output file ID from a Vertex AI batch response.

methods.name: _get_batch_job_status_from_vertex_ai_batch_response
methods.description: Maps Vertex AI job state to a BatchJobStatus value.

methods.name: _get_gcs_uri_prefix_from_file
methods.description: Extracts the GCS URI prefix from a given file URI.

methods.name: _get_model_from_gcs_file
methods.description: Extracts the model name from a GCS file URI uploaded via LiteLLM.
